claims: Saint Louis University was founded in 1818.
Saint Louis University offers over 100 undergraduate programs.
Saint Louis University has a 9:1 student-to-faculty ratio.
Saint Louis University is located in St. Louis, MO.
Saint Louis University has a campus in Madrid, Spain.
Saint Louis University has a 75% acceptance rate.
Saint Louis University has an average GPA of 3.79.
Saint Louis University's tuition for the 2023-2024 academic year is $53,244.
Saint Louis University's mid-50% ACT range is 25-31.
Saint Louis University's SAT range is 1200-1410.
Approximately 56.5% of Saint Louis University students are female.
43% of Saint Louis University students are male.
Saint Louis University is a private Jesuit research university.
Saint Louis University is a Catholic Jesuit research institution.
Saint Louis University's mascot is the Billiken.
Washington University in St. Louis (WashU) is a different institution from Saint Louis University.
